g.text: Common GND · connect to a Raspberry Pi GND pin
LED polarity: A = anode, K = cathode. Solid lines = external wiring; dashed lines = internal pull-ups.
Released button = HIGH; pressed button = LOW. Pin positions and breadboard layout are not represented.
